title: P–N heterojunction-enhanced structural stability of tungsten disulfide nanosheets for highly efficient, stable alkaline water electrolysis
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,50521-50530
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08680A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kumasser Kusse Kuchayita, Yohannes Asmare Fesseha, Chih-Wei Chiu, Jem-Kun Chen, Ai-Wei Lee, Chih-Chia Cheng
An exfoliated WS2 nanosheet electrocatalyst with a P–N heterojunction shows superior hydrogen evolution, durability, and stability, outperforming platinum/carbon catalysts and overcoming the structural instability of WS2 in alkaline conditions.
